orgs.estimated_depth: Multiple confirmed - at least 4 individual pages found in single search
orgs.notes: Pattern confirmed quickly with strong multiple examples. Subdomain give.encompassworldpartners.org with /person/<slug> path structure. Names are lowercase concatenations of first names (couples shown together).

orgs.estimated_depth: Multiple confirmed - at least 4 individual fund pages found
orgs.notes: Pattern confirmed with multiple examples. Subdomain give.maf.org with UUID-based fund structure including person names. Each entry has a numeric ID + person name slug following the structure <id>-<first-and-last-names>-ministry-support.

orgs.estimated_depth: Multiple surfaces confirmed - regional paths already known; /missionaries/ path is secondary surface
orgs.notes: SECOND SURFACE FOUND. In addition to known regional paths (fmwm.org/<region>/<lastname>/), discovered general /missionaries/<name> path at fmwm.org/missionaries/<name>/. This explains records in holdings citing only homepage - they may be reachable via /missionaries/ path in addition to regional paths. Both are path-based patterns on main domain.

orgs.estimated_depth: Multiple confirmed - at least 5 individual worker pages found in single search
orgs.notes: Pattern found on main domain with /global-worker/ path structure. Supports both numeric ID-based URLs (e.g., /208717/) and name-slug variants (e.g., /freeman). Names appear to be family-unit pairs or individuals. Some listings use numeric IDs for security/privacy of certain workers.
